# StockUp

StockUp is an Australian grocery price comparison app for iPhone and Android.
It compares available catalogue prices at Coles, Woolworths and ALDI.
Catalogue prices are updated weekly.
Product coverage, prices and availability vary by retailer and location.

Free features include search, specials browsing, product barcode lookup, a List for saved products and price alerts, and a Cart for quantities and shopping totals.
Users can choose the retailers shown.
Up to 30 days of available price history are free.
No sign-up is required for these features, and the free app includes advertising.

StockUp Premium is an optional monthly or yearly subscription.
It adds full recorded Price History, Price Intelligence, Smart Shop, Quick Cart, Past Purchases and an ad-free experience.
Current prices and eligible offers are shown in the app.
Sign-in is required for the current subscription flow.

Smart Shop can check available live prices and stock at a selected Coles or Woolworths store.
At ALDI, Smart Shop provides a checklist using catalogue prices, without live store prices or stock.
Quick Cart sends supported items to a user's Coles or Woolworths trolley for the user to review and check out.
It does not support ALDI checkout or place orders automatically.

Not every product has prices from every retailer.
ALDI-only products are also included.
Price Intelligence uses historical data and does not guarantee future specials.
StockUp does not currently offer a public browser shopping app.
It is independent and not affiliated with the retailers.
